card.title: 4th ALPINI REGIMENT
card.text: Deployment: Add a 4th ALPINI REGIMENT to your deck for every 10 cards in it.
card.flavorText: The 4th Alpini Regiment was one of the Royal Italian Army’s long-established mountain infantry units. By the outbreak of WWII, it formed part of the 1st Alpine Division “Taurinense” and fielded the Alpini battalions “Ivrea,” “Aosta,” and “Intra.” In June 1940, the regiment took part in the invasion of France, before serving on occupation duty in southern France. Elements of the regiment later fought in Albania during the Greco-Italian War, where the “Intra” Battalion and the regiment’s ski troops earned decorations for their actions. In October 1941, the regiment reformed the Skiers Battalion “Monte Cervino”, which was sent to the Eastern Front in early 1942. There, it served with the Italian 8th Army and was effectively destroyed during the Soviet Operation Little Saturn, later receiving a Gold Medal of Military Valor for its bravery and sacrifice. Meanwhile, the main regiment deployed to Montenegro with the “Taurinense” Division. After the Italian armistice in September 1943, the division fought German forces while attempting to reach the coast. By early October, its surviving elements were forced to surrender.
